judges_raw: (Before Dr Anita Sumanth and Mummineni Sudheer Kumar, JJ.)
case_number: WP No. 14589 of 2000 and WMP No. 21135 of 2000
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. P. Ananda Kumar Govt. Advocate
judgment_text:
PETITION filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the issuance of Writ Of Certiorari to call for the records relating to the order passed in M.P. No. 13 of 2000 in Diary No. 103 of 1999 on the file of the Tamil Nadu Land Reforms Special Appellate Tribunal Santhome, Chennai - 600 004 and quash the same.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— On the earlier occasion, learned counsel who had instituted the Writ Petition had reported no instructions, based on which, we have directed notice to be issued by the Registry.

2. Notice has been returned with the endorsement ‘left’. In any event, we had also directed the Registry to print the name of the petitioner in the cause list which has also been done today.

3. Despite the aforesaid, there is no appearance by, or on behalf of the petitioner. Hence, this Writ Petition and the connected Miscellaneous Petition are dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
